channel.description: Daily DP Show episodes without C&R or Best Of clips.

item.title: Hour 3 – Getting the Calls Right, Caleb Willams Return
item.description:
DP talks about some of the terrible calls by referees in the NFL and college football recently and how difficult it is for these officials to get it right. And he weighs in on Bears QB Caleb Williams successful return to action yesterday.

See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.
item.itunes:author: Dan Patrick

item.title: Hour 2 – Colts Pursuing Peyton Manning, Rick Neuheisel
item.description:
Dan addresses reports that the Indianapolis Colts are pursuing Peyton Manning to take over as their General Manager. And Rick Neuheisel drops by to weigh in on the crazy weekend of college football and the upcoming expansion of the College Football Playoff to 24 teams.

See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.
item.itunes:author: Dan Patrick

item.title: Hour 1 – NFL Week 6 Recap, CFP Expansion Will Make it Better
item.description:
Dan recaps another eventful week in the NFL, and an even more exciting week of college football. He is convinced expanding the College Football Playoff to 24 teams wouldn’t have lessened the entertainment value of the upsets we saw yesterday and that it will ultimately be a good thing for the sport.

See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.
item.itunes:author: Dan Patrick

item.title: Hour 3 – Overshadowed Tuesday, Grant Hill
item.description:
Dan and the Danettes discuss the great performances from Week 6 of the NFL season that may have gone overlooked. Plus, Grant Hill drops by to talk a little hoops as the NBA season tips off tonight.

See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.
item.itunes:author: Dan Patrick

item.title: Hour 2 – Cookout Etiquette, Louis Riddick
item.description:
Dan and the Danettes discuss whether it's acceptable to eat a hotdog without a traditional hotdog bun. And NFL insider Louis Riddick joined the show to give his insight into Hurts' situation as well as why he's high on CJ Stroud.

See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.
item.itunes:author: Dan Patrick

item.title: Hour 1 – Eagles Mishandling Jalen Hurts’ Bood Clots, NBA Begins
item.description:
Dan wonders why the Philadelphia Eagles haven’t had someone from their medical team address the media about Jalen Hurts’ blood clots. And the NAB tips off tonight and DP gets ready to talk some hoops.

See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.
item.itunes:author: Dan Patrick

item.title: Hour 3 – CFP Drama, NFL Best and Worst Offseason Moves
item.description:
Dan reacts to reports that Ohio State may be without QB Julian Sayin for the rest of the season. And he gives his best and worst NFL offseason moves now that we are officially 1/3 of the way through the season.

See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.
item.itunes:author: Dan Patrick

item.title: Hour 2 – NFLPA Demands Investigation for Jalen Hurts, Booger McFarland
item.description:
The NFL Players Association is demanding a thorough investigation into the medical treatment of Jalen Hurts and his blood clots after the NFL said everything was fine. NFL insider Booger McFarland drops by to weigh in on Jalen Hurts’ situation and the rest of the story lines entering Week 7 of the NFL season.

See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.
item.itunes:author: Dan Patrick

item.title: Hour 1 – No Dynasty for the Knicks, Pat Murphy
item.description:
DP weighs in on the opening night in the NBA where the defending champion New York Knicks lost to LeBron James and the 76ers and aren’t even favored to win the Eastern Conference. Plus, Milwaukee Brewers manager Pat Murphy joins the show as he gets his squad ready to face the Rays in the World Series.

See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.
item.itunes:author: Dan Patrick

item.title: Hour 3 – The Dominican LeBron, Mike Florio
item.description:
DP and the Danettes discuss Yaxel Lendeborg’s future in the NBA and his relatively unknown nickname: The Dominican LeBron. Dan interviews Pro Football Talk writer Mike Florio about the Giants’ decision to start J.J. McCarthy over Jameis Winston. They also discuss the NFL fining head coaches for interactions with officials, buyers and sellers at the trade deadline, and Josh Jacobs removal from the Commissioner’s Exempt List.

See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.
item.itunes:author: Dan Patrick

item.title: Hour 2 – Nobody Fears LeBron, Albert Breer
item.description:
Dan and the guys discuss why no one fears LeBron the way they did Larry Bird or Michael Jordan. And MMQB Senior Reporter Albert Breer stops by with an update on their game in Paris on Sunday between the Steelers and Saints considering the protests occurring in France.

See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.
item.itunes:author: Dan Patrick

item.title: Hour 1 – Yaxel vs. Luka, Booth Changes, Tom Waddle
item.description:
Yaxel Lendeborg and Luka Dončić had an epic battle last night and DP is here for it. DP and the Danettes consider Tony Romo’s broadcasting future and wonder if he could be Troy Aikman’s replacement for Monday Night Football considering the tension in the booth between him and Joe Buck. And former Chicago Bears receiver Tom Waddle drops by and weighs in on Caleb Williams, whether the Bears fear the Vikings, and tells some personal stories of Mike Ditka.

See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.
item.itunes:author: Dan Patrick

item.title: The Cutoff Episode 6: Who Will Hoist The Trophy?
item.description:
On this episode of The Cutoff, Dan G and Mario preview the World Series matchup between the Milwaukee Brewers and the Tampa Bay Rays, outlining their x-factors for the series as well as making their World Series predictions. Enjoy!

See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.
item.itunes:author: Dan Patrick

item.title: HOUR 3 – James Dolan screws over MSG employees, Dave McMenamin
item.description:
Dan and callers continue to discuss how James Dolan punked his own employees over NBA championship rings in an email, and then refuses to give them any. Dan’s wife knows Mike Vrabel’s name for a very specific reason. ESPN reporter Dave McMenamin joins Dan to talk about Lebron’s debut in Philadelphia as the Sixers come from behind against the Cavaliers, the championship prospects for the Sixers and what has to happen for Lebron to keep playing at a high level – and perhaps a second season in Philly.

See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.
item.itunes:author: Dan Patrick

item.title: Hour 2 – Alabama can’t keep up with modern college athletics, Kevin Fishbain
item.description:
Dan discusses the Alabama Crimson Tide and how the once-great giants find themselves in a sticky situation trying to play catch-up with the new money flying around college football. Senior writer for the Athletic Kevin Fishbain joins Dan to discuss the Thursday night victory for the Chicago Bears as they continue to put their stamp on the NFC North, and the growth of quarterback Caleb Williams into a strong pocket passer.

See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.
item.itunes:author: Dan Patrick

item.title: Hour 3 – Kenneth Walker Proving His Value, RG III Wants the Baylor Job
item.description:
Dan thinks last night’s Chiefs’ loss only proves that Kenneth Walker is a legitimate NFL MVP candidate. And Dan and the Danettes react to Robert Griffin III confirming his interest in coaching Baylor.

See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.
item.itunes:author: Dan Patrick

item.title: Hour 2 – WNBA Finals, Robert Griffin III
item.description:
With the WNBA Finals deciding Game 5 on tonight, DP talks about the league transitioning from a click-bait league to a legitimate sports league and the challenges it faces for legitimacy. And former NFL QB Robert Griffin drops by to weigh in on Week 7 of the NFL and talk about his interest in coaching Baylor.

See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.
item.itunes:author: Dan Patrick

item.title: Hour 1 – NFL Week 7 Recap, Peyton Manning Has Options
item.description:
Dan and the Danettes weigh in another eventful week of football from the NFL. Plus, DP defends his reporting on Peyton Manning and the Indianapolis Colts and ponders the future prospects for Peyton.

See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.
item.itunes:author: Dan Patrick

item.title: Hour 3 – Callers Weigh In, David Ortiz
item.description:
Dan engages with the listeners who call in about a variety of different topics. And David “Big Papi” Ortiz joins the show to break down the Brewers dominance in the World Series.

See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.
item.itunes:author: Dan Patrick

item.title: Hour 2 – Dominant Seasons, Ed Werder
item.description:
With the Brewers absolutely rolling through the MLB Playoffs, Dan and the Danettes discuss some of the most dominant teams in the history of sports. Plus, Cowboys insider Ed Werder drops by to weigh in on last night’s performance by “America’s Team.”

See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.
item.itunes:author: Dan Patrick

item.title: Hour 1 – Brewers Still Underrated, Fire Sale in Philly?
item.description:
Dan is enjoying the Brewers playoff run but understands they may not get the credit they are due because nobody is watching. And the Philadelphia Eagles got rolled by the Cowboys last night and DP wonders if they need to start retooling for next season.

See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.
item.itunes:author: Dan Patrick

item.title: Hour 3 – Say His Name, Steve Young
item.description:
A discussion of doppelgangers and movies devolves into DP defending the name of his family priest growing up. And Hall of Fame QB Steve Young stops by and admits he never passed the Bar.

See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.
item.itunes:author: Dan Patrick

item.title: Hour 2 – NBA Recap, Charles Barkley
item.description:
DP runs down an eventful night of NBA action and comments on how early season results conflict with our preseason expectations. And NBA legend Charles Barkley drops by and gets a personal impression from Frank Caliendo who makes a surprise appearance.

See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.
item.itunes:author: Dan Patrick

item.title: Hour 1 – Saving the Miz, Colts Fire Sale
item.description:
Dan reacts to last night’s World Series Game 4 where the Rays managed to stave off elimination only to face The Miz tomorrow in his “hero” moment. And DP assumes RB Jonathan Taylor is up for sale as the Colts appear to be throwing in the towel on this season as the trade deadline approaches.

See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.
item.itunes:author: Dan Patrick

item.title: Hour 3 – Tom Verducci, Jeffery Simmons to the Bears, Justin Tucker to the Chiefs
item.description:
MLB insider Tom Verducci drops by to weigh in on the Milwaukee Brewers’ World Series win. Plus, DP and the Danettes hit some of the latest stories from the NFL, including the Bears trading for Jeffrey Simmons and the Chiefs signing controversial kicker Justin Tucker.

See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.
item.itunes:author: Dan Patrick

item.title: Hour 2 – Ernie Johnson, Lincoln Riley’s Future
item.description:
DP and the Danettes discuss Lincoln Riley’s future with USC and LSU HC Lane Kiffin’s complaints about their game time vs. Alabama this weekend. And legendary broadcaster Ernie Johnson joins the show to talk about his retirement from Inside the NBA and opens up about what prompted his decision to hang up the microphone.

See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.
item.itunes:author: Dan Patrick

item.title: Hour 1 – Brewers Crowned, Ernie Johnson Announces Retirement
item.description:
Dan talks about legendary broadcaster Ernie Johnson’s retirement announcement from being the host of Inside the NBA. Plus, DP and the Danettes celebrate the Milwaukee Brewers winning the World Series last night.

See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.
item.itunes:author: Dan Patrick

item.title: Hour 3 – Future Stars, Joe Thomas
item.description:
Dan and the crew reminisce about future NFL stars they observed early in their college careers. NFL Hall of Fame offensive tackle Joe Thomas joins the show and shares a Tom Brady story, talks about playing for the lowly Cleveland Browns, discusses the Quenton Nelson trade, and much more.

See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.
item.itunes:author: Dan Patrick

item.title: Hour 2 – Christian Watson Mid-Game ER Visit, Jason Garrett
item.description:
Packers WR Christian Watson went to the hospital in the middle of Thursday Night Football, but then somehow got back to the field as the Packers roll to victory. Former Cowboys coach and NBC football commentator Jason Garrett joins Dan to break down how good the Vikings are, the surprising revival of JJ McCarthy in New York, and the historic greatness of Emmitt Smith.

See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.
item.itunes:author: Dan Patrick

item.title: Hour 1 – Packers Survive the Panthers on TNF, Lincoln Riley Under the Gun
item.description:
The Packers take Thursday Night Football against the Panthers as the AFC North heats up. DP and the Danettes discuss the ultra-competitive division that has the undefeated Vikings barely favored to win the division. USC HC Lincoln Riley had a rough week with the media and now he must contend with Ohio State on Saturday.

See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.

item.title: The Cutoff Episode 7: Fruitious Season For Milwaukee
item.description:
On this episode of the Cutoff, Dan G and Mario react to the Milwaukee Brewers beating the Tampa Bay Rays in 5 games to win their first World Series Title. They touch on who they think should have won World Series MVP, how sustainable are the Brewers going forward, and gave their predictions on when next season will start with a possible lockout on the horizon.

See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.
